The '''Galactic lightball playoffs''' was a sporting event involving the game [[lightball]] that was held during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Wuglik]] and [[Yatter]] once watched them on a [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] in the [[Cantina Oceana]].
